title: Creamy tomato pasta
description: Silky tomato cream sauce with basil and a little parmesan. A weeknight favorite made in one pan.
instructions: Cook pasta in well-salted water until just al dente.
Soften tomatoes in olive oil, then stir in cream and a splash of pasta water.
Toss with pasta, finish with basil and parmesan, and serve.

title: The everyday green bowl
description: A bright, nourishing bowl filled with crisp greens, grains and a lemony dressing.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions and let cool slightly.
Slice the vegetables and arrange over greens.
Whisk olive oil and lemon, drizzle generously, and finish with flaky salt.

title: Golden chicken & rice
description: Tender spiced chicken over fluffy rice with a cool, herby yogurt sauce.
instructions: Season chicken with paprika, cumin, salt and pepper.
Sear until golden and cooked through.
Steam rice until fluffy; serve with chicken, yogurt and lemon.

title: Sunday berry pancakes
description: Soft, golden pancakes piled high with seasonal berries and a little maple syrup.
instructions: Whisk flour, milk and egg until just combined.
Cook small ladles of batter on a buttered skillet until bubbles form.
Flip, cook until golden, and top with berries and maple syrup.

title: Miso-glazed salmon
description: A glossy, savory-sweet glaze and crisp greens make this an easy dinner to remember.
instructions: Mix miso and honey and brush over the salmon.
Roast at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until just cooked.
Steam broccoli and serve alongside the glazed salmon.

title: Citrus & fennel salad
description: A crisp, fragrant salad with sweet oranges, shaved fennel and toasted almonds.
instructions: Toast almonds in a dry pan until fragrant.
Slice oranges and shave fennel as thinly as possible.
Arrange over rocket and dress with olive oil and citrus juice.

title: Dark chocolate mousse
description: An airy, deeply chocolatey dessert that feels special and takes just a few ingredients.
instructions: Melt the chocolate gently and let it cool slightly.
Whisk egg whites to soft peaks with the sugar.
Fold yolks and whipped cream into chocolate, then gently fold in whites. Chill for 3 hours.

title: Smoky lentil soup
description: A hearty pot of red lentils, tomatoes and warming spices for the coziest evenings.
instructions: Soften onion in a little oil, then stir in paprika.
Add lentils, tomatoes and stock; bring to a simmer.
Cook for 20 minutes until tender. Season and serve with lemon.

title: Peach & ricotta toast
description: Creamy ricotta, juicy peaches and honey on crisp sourdough—a slow morning in a bite.
instructions: Toast sourdough until crisp and golden.
Spread thickly with ricotta.
Add sliced peaches and finish with honey and a pinch of black pepper.
